'''Broodica's grimoire''' was a large [[Book/Legends|book]] owned by [[Broodica]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who [[Exiles|co-founded]] the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] after the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. While obsessively collecting the ancient [[Sith scroll/Legends|scrolls]] and tablets of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith civilization]], Broodica transferred these findings into the grimoire. The book was sealed by a unique lock of Broodica's own design, resembling a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]].<ref name="FaD" />
